Subject: Discovery recap + vendor intake questions for Meridien Health

Hi Sophie — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our side and a few procurement/vendor intake questions so your ops team can route this quickly.

What we discussed (short):
- Goal: Pilot inference for clinical summarization on approximately 300k notes/month; reduce downstream review time by ~30%.
- Decision criteria: accuracy on our test prompts, latency under 200ms p95, and predictable unit cost.
- Timeline: pilot kickoff target early Aug (customer requested onboarding window).

Procurement / vendor-intake questions for your team:
1) Who is the formal procurement contact (name + email) who completes vendor forms and issues POs?
2) Does Meridien require a PO up front for pilot? If yes, preferred PO value and invoice cadence (Net30/Net45)?
3) Legal: do you expect a standard redline cycle (in-house counsel) or will you route to outside counsel? Typical review lead time?
4) Security evidence: we provided SOC 2 Type II and a standard DPA during the call — any additional attestations needed (ISO27001, penetration test report)?
5) Onboarding: any internal intake form or vendor portal we should fill before the kickoff?

Attached: redwood-vendor-intake-checklist.pdf (summary of docs we can provide) and our standard_sow_template.docx for budgeting.

Proposed next step: if you can share procurement contact and preferred PO/invoice cadence, I’ll schedule a 30-min intake with procurement + legal to align timeline.

Thanks — Rishi

Hi Rishi — great call, thanks. Please see answers below and I’ve looped in our procurement mailbox.

1) Procurement contact: ops-procure@meridienhealth.com (primary). For commercial review please include Jason Turner (jason.turner@meridienhealth.com) — he’s the payments lead.
2) PO: Yes, we require a PO for pilots > $5k. Typical process is PO issued after SOW approval; invoices are Net30. We can issue a short-form PO for pilots if legal signs off.
3) Legal review: In-house counsel will do the first pass. Expect 7–10 business days for standard SaaS SOWs; if there are non-standard clauses it can go to outside counsel and add another 7–14 days.
4) Security evidence: SOC 2 Type II and a signed DPA are mandatory. ISO27001 is not required but good to have. Pen test reports are reviewed on request for production environments only.
5) Vendor portal: please fill Meridien Vendor Intake Form — I’ve attached our completed vendor form (filled by procurement) for your reference.

I attached meridien_vendor_form_filled.pdf — it includes fields for tax ID, remittance address, and invoice contact.

Next steps: I can coordinate a 30-min intake meeting the week of Jun 14 if that works. Please share availability and any pre-read docs.

Best,
Sophie

Rishi — quick internal note following Sophie’s details. A couple tactical suggestions to accelerate PO path:

- Offer a one-time $2k onboarding credit explicitly for the pilot deliverable (smoothing procurement’s numbers and enabling a smaller initial PO).
- Add a short appendix to the SOW that maps success criteria (latency, accuracy threshold, sample prompts) — makes legal comfortable and reduces back-and-forth.
- For billing, propose two invoices: 50% on SOW signature (to align with PO) and 50% at pilot completion — keeps Net30 cadence but helps cashflow for both sides.

If we’re comfortable with the credit and 2-invoice structure, I’ll draft the SOW appendix and talk to finance to confirm they’ll accept the split. Also we should prepare the SOC2 + DPA packet for the meeting.

Action: Rishi, propose 3 available slots for intake next week and I’ll prepare the appendix draft.

Thanks — Lauren
